args.name: Small steps — orange robot watering a plant

style.prompt: An 8-second widescreen 16:9 charming cartoon animation. A little orange robot with rounded shapes and friendly eyes gently waters a leafy green plant in a terracotta pot with a small watering can. Cozy pastel background, clean 2D cartoon shapes, warm optimistic mood. Single continuous locked-off wide shot, robot and entire potted plant clearly visible. The robot tilts the can, a gentle stream waters the soil, then returns the can upright. Throughout the entire video from first frame to last frame, display the exact words 'Small steps' in large crisp readable dark lettering centered at the top, stationary and unchanged. Reserve clear space above the robot for this title, no overlap. No other text. Silent video, no music, no dialogue, no sound.
